result.planSummary: Extended the existing workbench query/reporting path to expose chunk transcript readiness, detailed/brief status, failure details, and compact blocker metadata; wired that report into a new PI command and CLI script; and taught active rollout inspection to surface recent lower-band prepare-catch-up events from operational logs.

changedFiles.reason: Added rich lower-band status inspection/report output, compact blocker extraction, and JSON formatting alongside the existing readiness API.
Added `/lh-lower-band-status` command parsing, execution, and notification wiring through the shared workbench query service.
Surfaced recent lower-band prepare-catch-up events from operational logs in rollout inspection output and warnings.
Included generation mode metadata in lower-band operational log records so prepare catch-up events can be identified by inspection surfaces.
Added the developer CLI entry point that delegates to the shared lower-band inspection report.
Added coverage for transcript readiness, band failure/error reporting, compact blockers, and non-evaluative lower-band inspection output.
Added command-surface coverage for `/lh-lower-band-status` JSON output.
Added narrow CLI proof that lower-band inspection can be reached through a real command surface against a live store.
Added coverage for catch-up visibility through rollout inspection surfaces.

gatesRun.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern "^/lh-lower-band-status reaches the real operator command surface with truthful chunk readiness output$" tests/context-steward/e2e-cli.e2e.test.ts

findingsFixed: Added a lower-band inspection report that exposes transcript readiness, detailed/brief ready-pending-failed state, and last error details without introducing eval-style scoring.
Added shared PI and CLI lower-band inspection entry points instead of creating a parallel inspection path.
Exposed recent prepare catch-up events through active rollout inspection by reading lower-band operational logs with chunk/band context.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to story verification using the new `/lh-lower-band-status` and `scripts/inspect-lower-band-status.ts` surfaces alongside the existing rollout/compaction reports.
